title: Ordering-equivalence and cross-language verification component
responsibilities: Execute the T020 ordering-equivalence verification and the Python cross-language leg over the accepted plan chain.
Prove canonical-byte and domain-separated-digest identity across equivalent plan representations.
state_ownership: none; the component holds no state and owns no runtime resource
concurrency: offline-single-threaded; one test process, no thread, no mutable shared state
errors: GoogleTest assertion failure or pytest failure on an unexpected outcome, code, canonical byte, or digest
deployment: repository-local test process; no runtime deployment and no activation
rationale: The accepted T009 boundary XCOM-XB-003 (plan to core decoder, carrying XCOM-XLC-001) is consumed read-only; T020 proves the equivalence property there without creating a new component.
